shots.visual: Burning valley with smoke rising, scattered enemy flags on the ground, fire reflecting in the eyes.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 曹軍……竟然真的在此全軍覆沒！

shots.visual: A trembling hand holding a broken feather fan, sweat dripping from the forehead.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 分毫不差，主公難道真能預知未來？

shots.visual: Standing on a high ridge with back to the camera, looking down at the burning battlefield.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這點小勝，不值得驚訝。

shots.visual: Turning slightly, showing a cold and sharp side profile with a subtle smirk.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孔明，回營再議。

shots.visual: Walking into the tent, eyes immediately fixed on the new war map on the table.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，這地圖上的標註是？

shots.visual: Finger pointing sharply at a specific mountain range on the map.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這是曹丕明日會派兵增援的路徑。

shots.visual: A look of pure shock, pupils Dilating while staring at the map.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 連增援路線都算到了？這不可能！

shots.visual: Sitting down slowly, the atmosphere becomes heavy and oppressive.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 在孤眼裡，沒有什麼是不可能的。

shots.visual: Lowering voice, stepping closer with hands clasped in respect but with hesitation.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公近日用兵，似乎過於險峻。

shots.visual: Eyes showing deep concern, searching for the familiar benevolence in the other's eyes.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這與以往的仁義之道，大相徑庭。

shots.visual: Eyes snapping up, cold and piercing like a predator.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 仁義能換回二弟三弟的命嗎？

shots.visual: Flinching slightly at the sudden burst of anger.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 亮並非此意，只是擔心……

shots.visual: Standing up and walking toward the tent exit, ignoring the advice.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 你只需要執行孤的命令。

shots.visual: Stopping at the curtain, face partially in shadow.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 其他的，不需要你多言。

shots.visual: Left alone in the tent, looking at the empty high chair.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公以前，從不對亮如此說話。

shots.visual: Picking up a piece of paper on the table, hands shaking.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這計畫……竟要將曹軍降卒全滅？

shots.visual: Horrified expression as the cruelty of the strategy sinks in.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這簡直是……暴君所為！

shots.visual: Outside the tent, silhouette standing tall under the moonlight, looking like a different person.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 成大事者，不拘仁義。

shots.visual: A cold, determined gaze directed at the stars.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 這天下，終將姓劉！

shots.visual: Looking through the tent slit at the back of the figure outside.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這還是我認識的那位皇叔嗎？

shots.visual: A single tear falling on the feather fan, the light in the tent flickers and dies.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 仁心已死，霸主降世。
